title: Herbal Shaggy Tagine Chicken
description: A flavorful Italian-inspired dish with chicken, herbal spices, and a tangy tamarind sauce, all slow-cooked in a traditional tagine.

ingredients.name: algerian spices
ingredients.notes: a blend of herbs and spices

instructions: Preheat the tagine or a large Dutch oven to 300°F (150°C).
Season the chicken with Algerian spices, salt, and pepper.
Heat the herbal olive oil in the preheated tagine over medium heat.
Add the garlic and onion to the tagine and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the chicken to the tagine, skin side up, and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the tamarind paste, shaggy parmesan, and 1 cup of chicken broth to the tagine.
Cover the tagine and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the dish for 30-40 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve the chicken and sauce over couscous or rice.
